summary: Ampache is a PHP self-hosted music/media streaming server: it catalogs on-disk/remote/podcast media into DB records (Song/Album/Artist/AlbumDisk/Video/Podcast/PodcastEpisode), serves them over web/JSON/XML/Subsonic APIs, and tracks per-user ratings, favorite flags, play statistics, playlists/smart lists/collections, shares, bookmarks, broadcasts, radio/live-streams, wanted albums, labels, tags/moods, private messages, shouts and follows.
